                            Occupational English Test Practice Papers




Writing Test 1 – Nurses
Time allowed: 40 minutes
Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
Hospital            Royal Prince Alfred Hospital


Patient Details     Alexander Jones
                    65 years old
                    Marital status: divorced
                    Next of kin: No living relatives –
                    Ex wife to be contacted in case of emergency:
                    Sandra Jones, 59 William Crescent, Smithtown
                    0415 835 565

Admission Date      10/05/06

Discharge Date      10/06/06

Diagnosis           Basal cell carcimona L calf

Past Medical        No prior hospitalizations, no known allergies, no known
History             medications

Social              Retired postman,
History/Supports    Lives alone: rented flat
                    Age pension
                    Hobbies: running, swimming, weight training, music,
                    movies
                    Regular exercise
                    Smoker, <10 cigs per day
                    Drinks: beer only <5 per day
                    Fair skin
                    Religion: Roman Catholic

                    No home aids installed by OT
                    Friends local
                    Good relationship ex-wife
 
Medical Progress       basal cell carcinoma - removal of
                       never admitted to hospital previous
                       medications: panadein forte 500mg



Nursing                wound management – no complications
Management             fully alert on discharge
                       walking w aid of crutches
                       hygiene: self managed
Discharge Plan         continence: self managed


                       daily dressing check L calf
                       daily obs.
                       Continue med for a week then PRN
                       Investigate possible need of other services
                       Hygiene self managed




Writing Task
You are the charge nurse on the hospital ward where Mr. Jones has recently
had his operation.

Using the information provided in the case notes, write a referral letter to the
Community Nurse Supervisor at the Community Nursing Centre, Ashfield,
who will be attending to Mr. Jones following his discharge.

In your answer:

   Expand the relevant case notes into complete sentences.

   Do not use note form.

   The body of the letter should be approximately 200 words.

   Use correct letter format.
